project.name: SASTRE DSL
project.description: A tool for creating clothing patterns using a domain-specific language, with geometric representation and SVG export
project.coordinate_system: SVG standard: origin top-left, Y-down, units in mm
project.build_order: bottom-up: geometry → model → SVG → DSL → pattern → CLI → AI

phases.title: Fundaciones del proyecto
phases.description: Configuración del repositorio, herramientas de desarrollo, estructura de directorios, testing, linting, documentación base

phases.title: Fundamentos matemáticos y geométricos
phases.description: Primitivas geométricas fundamentales: Point, Vector, Line, Segment, Bezier, Circle, Arc, Path, Polygon, intersecciones, transformaciones, offsets, mediciones

phases.title: Modelo geométrico intermedio
phases.description: Modelo nombrado con entidades, registro, grafo de dependencias DAG, detección de referencias inválidas

phases.title: Renderer SVG
phases.description: Generación de SVG a partir del modelo geométrico: documento, viewBox, unidades, layers, estilos, exportación

phases.title: DSL mínimo v0.1
phases.description: Lenguaje de comandos básico: lexer, parser, AST, comandos de geometría, referencias, errores, exportación SVG

phases.title: DSL paramétrico v0.2
phases.description: Variables, medidas, fórmulas, expresiones, dependencias, recalculación, unidades explícitas

phases.title: Modelo de patrón
phases.description: Evolución desde geometría pura hacia conceptos de patronaje: Piece, seam, contour, grainline, notch, dart, label, seam allowance

phases.title: Operaciones de patronaje
phases.description: Offsets de contornos, márgenes de costura, piquetes, líneas de hilo, doblez, transformaciones de piezas, prolongaciones

phases.title: Validación geométrica y de patrones
phases.description: Validadores: referencias inexistentes, geometría degenerada, curvas inválidas, paths abiertos, autointersecciones, puntos duplicados

phases.title: CLI
phases.description: Interfaz de terminal: build, inspect, validate, export. Diseño para uso por agentes de IA.

phases.title: Sistema de inspección
phases.description: Comandos de inspección: puntos, líneas, curvas, paths, longitudes, ángulos, intersecciones, bounding boxes, errores, dependencias

phases.title: Patrones de referencia
phases.description: Patrones de prueba progresivos: rectángulo → polígono → curvas → pieza simple → base pantalón → delantero boxer → trasero boxer → boxer completo

phases.title: Tests completos
phases.description: Tests unitarios, integración, regresión, patrones de referencia, property-based testing

phases.title: Documentación
phases.description: Documentación de arquitectura, geometría, DSL, sintaxis, ejemplos, decisiones, patrones, guía para agentes IA

tasks.title: Inicializar proyecto TypeScript
tasks.description: Crear package.json con dependencias: typescript, vitest, eslint, @typescript-eslint/*, svgo. Configurar tsconfig.json con strict mode, ESM modules, target ES2022.
acceptance_criteria: tsconfig.json with strict: true, module: ESNext, target: ES2022
notes: Must be first task — all other tasks depend on this

tasks.title: Configurar ESLint
tasks.description: Configurar ESLint con @typescript-eslint/recommended y reglas estrictas. Crear .eslintrc.json con configuración del proyecto.
acceptance_criteria: eslint src/ completes (may find lint issues in empty project)
Rules enforce: no any, no implicit returns, consistent type imports

tasks.title: Configurar Vitest
tasks.description: Configurar Vitest con configuración para el proyecto. Crear vitest.config.ts con paths de test y coverage.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest --run completes with 0 tests (empty suite)

tasks.title: Crear estructura de directorios
tasks.description: Crear árbol de directorios src/ con subdirectorios: geometry/, model/, dsl/, svg/, pattern/, cli/, validation/. Crear index.ts vacíos en cada módulo.
acceptance_criteria: Each module has an index.ts (can be empty export)

tasks.title: Configurar scripts npm
tasks.description: Crear scripts en package.json: build, test, lint, typecheck, dev, clean. Configurar npm run all para ejecutar todo.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles without errors

tasks.title: Crear README.md base
tasks.description: README con: nombre, descripción, requisitos, instalación, estructura, convenciones, enlaces a documentación.
acceptance_criteria: Contains: project name, description, prerequisites, installation, project structure, contributing guidelines

tasks.title: Crear .gitignore
tasks.description: Configurar .gitignore para: node_modules, dist, coverage, .env, editor files, OS files.

tasks.title: Crear testing utilities
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/__tests__/helpers.ts con: assertPointsEqual, assertSegmentsEqual, TOLERANCE constant, makePoint helper.

tasks.title: Implementar Point2D
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Point.ts con interfaz Point2D {x: number, y: number} y funciones: makePoint, equals (con tolerance), add, subtract, distanceTo, midpoint, toString.
acceptance_criteria: equals(a, b, tolerance) returns true for close points
notes: Foundation for all geometry — must be correct

tasks.title: Tests de Point2D
tasks.description: Tests unitarios para todas las funciones de Point2D: makePoint, equals, add, subtract, distanceTo, midpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Test equals with same point returns true
Test equals with distant points returns false
Test equals within tolerance returns true

tasks.title: Implementar Vector2D
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Vector.ts con interfaz Vector2D {x: number, y: number} y funciones: makeVector, fromPoints, length, normalize, dot, cross, add, subtract, scale, perpendicular, angle, rotate.
acceptance_criteria: fromPoints(a, b) creates vector from a to b

tasks.title: Tests de Vector2D
tasks.description: Tests unitarios para todas las funciones de Vector2D.

tasks.title: Implementar Line (infinita)
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Line.ts con representación implícita ax + by + c = 0. Funciones: fromTwoPoints, fromPointAndNormal, fromPointAndDirection, distanceToPoint, closestPoint, containsPoint, intersect.
acceptance_criteria: Line represented as {a, b, c} where ax + by + c = 0
containsPoint checks point on line within tolerance
intersect returns intersection point or null

tasks.title: Tests de Line
tasks.description: Tests unitarios para Line: construction, distance, closest point, contains, intersection.
acceptance_criteria: Test distanceToPoint for point above/below/on line
Test closestPoint on horizontal and diagonal lines
Test containsPoint for point on line
Test intersect two parallel lines returns null

tasks.title: Implementar Segment
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Segment.ts con interfaz Segment {from: Point2D, to: Point2D}. Funciones: makeSegment, length, midpoint, direction, normal, boundingBox, pointAt (t parameter), project (closest point on segment), containsPoint.
acceptance_criteria: pointAt(t) interpolates at parameter t in [0,1]
project returns closest point on segment
containsPoint checks if point lies on segment

tasks.title: Tests de Segment
tasks.description: Tests unitarios para Segment: construction, length, midpoint, direction, normal, boundingBox, pointAt, project, containsPoint.
acceptance_criteria: Test length of horizontal, vertical, diagonal segments
Test pointAt(0) = from, pointAt(1) = to, pointAt(0.5) = midpoint
Test project for point on segment, off segment start, off segment end
Test containsPoint for point on/off segment

tasks.title: Implementar Ray
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Ray.ts con interfaz Ray {origin: Point2D, direction: Vector2D}. Funciones: makeRay, fromTwoPoints, intersectSegment, intersectRay, pointAt.
acceptance_criteria: fromTwoPoints creates ray from a through b
intersectRay returns intersection or null (parallel check)
pointAt(t) returns point at distance t along ray

tasks.title: Implementar Circle
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Circle.ts con interfaz Circle {center: Point2D, radius: number}. Funciones: makeCircle, area, circumference, containsPoint, distanceToCenter, intersectLine, intersectCircle, tangentAt.
acceptance_criteria: tangentAt returns tangent line at point on circle

tasks.title: Implementar Arc
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Arc.ts con interfaz Arc {center, radius, startAngle, endAngle, ccw}. Funciones: makeArc, fromThreePoints, fromCenterRadiusAngles, pointAt, length, boundingBox, toBezier (approximate as cubic Bezier).
acceptance_criteria: Arc interface exported with all fields
fromThreePoints creates arc through three points
pointAt(t) returns point at parameter t
toBezier approximates arc as cubic Bezier

tasks.title: Implementar Bezier cuadrática
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Bezier.ts con tipo BezierQuadratic {p0, p1, p2}. Funciones: evaluateQ, derivativeQ, splitQ, flatnessQ, toPointsQ (flatten to polyline).
acceptance_criteria: splitQ at t=0.5 produces two valid sub-curves
flatnessQ measures deviation from control polygon
toPointsQ produces N points along curve

tasks.title: Implementar Bezier cúbica
tasks.description: Añadir a Bezier.ts: BezierCubic {p0, p1, p2, p3}. Funciones: evaluateC, derivativeC, splitC, flatnessC, toPointsC, lengthC (adaptive flatten), tangentAtC, normalAtC.
acceptance_criteria: splitC at parameter t produces two valid sub-curves
flatnessC measures max deviation from chord
lengthC uses adaptive flatten with 0.01mm tolerance
tangentAtC returns unit tangent vector at t
normalAtC returns unit normal vector at t
notes: Most critical curve type for pattern making — armholes, necklines, crotch curves

tasks.title: Tests de Bezier cúbica
tasks.description: Tests exhaustivos: evaluación en t=0, t=1, t=0.5, derivada, splitting, flatness, longitud, tangente, normal.
acceptance_criteria: Test evaluateC(0.5) matches manual de Casteljau
Test derivativeC at endpoints matches expected tangents
Test splitC produces sub-curves that evaluate to same points
Test lengthC of straight line segment equals distance(p0, p3)
Test flatnessC of straight line is ~0
Test tangentAtC is perpendicular to normalAtC

tasks.title: Implementar intersecciones Line-Line
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Intersection.ts con función intersectLines(l1, l2) que retorna punto de intersección o null (paralelas/coincidentes). Incluir tolerancia epsilon.
acceptance_criteria: intersectLines returns Point2D for non-parallel lines
intersectLines returns null for parallel lines
intersectLines returns null for coincident lines (degenerate)
Result is within tolerance for known geometric cases
Handles vertical and horizontal lines correctly

tasks.title: Implementar intersecciones Segment-Segment y Line-Segment
tasks.description: Añadir a Intersection.ts: intersectSegments(s1, s2), intersectLineSegment(line, seg). Manejar colineales, paralelas, intersección en endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: intersectSegments returns Point2D within both segments
intersectSegments returns null for non-overlapping segments
intersectLineSegment works for infinite line vs finite segment

tasks.title: Implementar Path
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Path.ts con interfaz Path {segments: PathSegment[], closed: boolean}. Tipo PathSegment = line | bezier | arc. Funciones: makePath, addSegment, toPoints (flatten all), boundingBox, length, isClosed.
acceptance_criteria: Path interface with segments array and closed flag
PathSegment discriminated union: line | bezier | arc
toPoints flattens all segments to polyline
isClosed checks if last point connects to first

tasks.title: Implementar Polygon
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Polygon.ts con interfaz Polygon {vertices: Point2D[], edges: PathSegment[]}. Funciones: makePolygon, area, centroid, containsPoint (ray casting), perimeter, isConvex, vertices.

tasks.title: Implementar Transformaciones
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Transform.ts con funciones: rotate(points, angle, center), translate(points, dx, dy), scale(points, sx, sy, center), reflect(points, axis). Cada función opera sobre arrays de Point2D.
acceptance_criteria: rotate rotates points around center by angle
translate shifts all points by (dx, dy)

tasks.title: Implementar Offset (curvas paralelas)
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Offset.ts con función offsetPath(path, distance) que retorna nuevo Path con cada punto desplazado por distancia a lo largo de su normal. Manejar esquinas (extender/trim segmentos offsets).
acceptance_criteria: offsetPath on straight segment produces parallel segment
offsetPath on curve samples N points and displaces
Result distance from original is approximately constant
notes: Critical for seam allowances — must handle curves correctly

tasks.title: Implementar proyecciones y tangentes
tasks.description: Añadir a archivos existentes: projectPointOnPath, tangentAtPoint (para path), normalAtPoint (para path). Usar en Segment.ts y Bezier.ts.
acceptance_criteria: projectPointOnPath returns closest point on path
tangentAtPath returns tangent direction at parameter
normalAtPath returns perpendicular direction at parameter
Works for line segments, Bezier curves, and arcs

tasks.title: Implementar intersecciones con curvas
tasks.description: Añadir a Intersection.ts: intersectLineBezier(line, bezier) y intersectBezierBezier(bez1, bez2). Usar subdivisión recursiva con bounding-box pruning.
acceptance_criteria: intersectLineBezier returns array of intersection points
intersectBezierBezier returns array of intersection points
Handles no-intersection cases (bounding boxes don't overlap)
Precision within tolerance for all cases

tasks.title: Implementar Measure (mediciones)
tasks.description: Crear src/geometry/Measure.ts con funciones: distance(a, b), angle(a, b), angleBetween(v1, v2), area(polygon), arcLength(arc), pathLength(path), boundingBox(path).
acceptance_criteria: angle returns angle of vector from horizontal
angleBetween returns angle between two vectors
area returns signed area of polygon
arcLength returns arc length of circular arc

tasks.title: Implementar GeometryEntity base
tasks.description: Crear src/model/Entity.ts con interfaz GeometryEntity {id: string, kind: string, dependencies: string[], span?: SourceSpan}. Tipo EntityKind = 'point' | 'line' | 'curve' | 'path'.
acceptance_criteria: All entities have id, kind, dependencies
Optional span for source location tracking

tasks.title: Implementar PointEntity
tasks.description: Crear src/model/PointEntity.ts con tipo PointEntity extends GeometryEntity {kind: 'point', position: Point2D | ExprRef}. Soportar posición absoluta o referencia a fórmula.
acceptance_criteria: Position can be Point2D or expression reference
Dependencies are tracked from expression references

tasks.title: Implementar CurveEntity
tasks.description: Crear src/model/CurveEntity.ts con tipos para línea, curva Bezier, y arco nombrados. Cada uno con referencias a puntos de control existentes.
acceptance_criteria: ArcEntity references center, start, end points

tasks.title: Implementar PathEntity
tasks.description: Crear src/model/PathEntity.ts con PathEntity {name, segments: (LineRef | CurveRef)[], closed: boolean}. Referenciar entidades existentes por nombre.
acceptance_criteria: PathEntity has name, segments array, closed flag
Segments reference existing CurveEntity/LineEntity by name
Dependencies collected from all segment references
Path can be resolved to geometric Path

tasks.title: Implementar Registry y DAG
tasks.description: Crear src/model/Registry.ts con Registro de entidades por nombre y grafo de dependencias DAG. Funciones: add, get, has, resolve (topological sort), validate (detect cycles, missing refs).
acceptance_criteria: Registry stores entities by unique name

tasks.title: Implementar SVG document builder
tasks.description: Crear src/svg/Renderer.ts con función renderSVG(model, options) que genera string SVG válido. Estructura: <?xml?> + <svg> con viewBox, <style>, <g> groups por pieza.
acceptance_criteria: Empty model produces minimal valid SVG

tasks.title: Implementar elementos SVG (path, line, circle, text)
tasks.description: Crear src/svg/Elements.ts con funciones builder para cada tipo SVG: pathFromGeometry(path), lineFromSegment(seg), circleElement(center, r), textLabel(point, text, options).
acceptance_criteria: lineFromSegment generates <line x1=... y1=... x2=... y2=...>
All coordinates rounded to 2 decimal places

tasks.title: Implementar estilos SVG
tasks.description: Crear src/svg/Styles.ts con CSS para: .cut-line (solid black), .seam-line (dashed), .construction (dotted gray), .grainline (arrow), .notch (short line), .label (text).
acceptance_criteria: Styles object with all CSS class definitions
Classes match SVG element class attributes

tasks.title: Implementar exportación SVG
tasks.description: Crear src/svg/Export.ts con función exportSVG(svgString, outputPath) y opcional optimización SVGO. Escribir archivo con encoding UTF-8.
acceptance_criteria: exportSVG writes SVG string to file

tasks.title: Implementar tipos de Token
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Token.ts con tipo TokenType (KEYWORD, IDENTIFIER, NUMBER, UNIT, STRING, OPERATOR, PUNCTUATION, EOF) y interfaz Token {type, value, span}.
acceptance_criteria: TokenType enum with all token categories
Token interface with type, value, span
Keywords list: POINT, LINE, CURVE, PATH, CUT, END, EXPORT, INPUT, LET

tasks.title: Implementar Lexer
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Lexer.ts con función tokenize(source: string): Token[]. Manejar: whitespace (skip), numbers (int/float), units (cm/mm/in), identifiers, keywords, operators, strings, comments (//), newlines.

tasks.title: Tests del Lexer
tasks.description: Tests exhaustivos del lexer: tokens individuales, combinaciones, comentarios, errores, tracking de posición.
acceptance_criteria: Test multi-line tokenization with line tracking

tasks.title: Definir tipos AST
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/AST.ts con tipos de nodos AST como discriminated unions: Program, PointDecl, LineDecl, CurveDecl, PathDecl, CutDecl, ExportDecl, Expr, BinExpr, NumberLiteral, Identifier, etc. Cada nodo con span.
acceptance_criteria: All AST node types defined as discriminated unions
Every node has kind tag and span
Program is root node with declarations array
Expression types: number, identifier, binary, unary, call
TypeScript exhaustive checking works on all node kinds

tasks.title: Implementar Parser (recursive descent)
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Parser.ts con parser recursivo descendente. Función parse(tokens): Program. Manejar: POINT, LINE, CURVE, PATH, CUT, END, EXPORT. Incluir error recovery (panic mode a ; o END).
acceptance_criteria: Error recovery: skip to next statement on error
notes: Core DSL component — must be thoroughly tested

tasks.title: Tests del Parser
tasks.description: Tests exhaustivos: cada tipo de declaración, combinaciones, errores de sintaxis, recuperación de errores, tracking de posición.
acceptance_criteria: Test parse LINE between two points
Test parse CURVE with control points
Test parse PATH with multiple segments
Test parse CUT with path reference
Test syntax error produces error with line/column
Test error recovery continues parsing after error

tasks.title: Implementar Pratt expression parser
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Pratt.ts con parser de expresiones: aritmética (+,-,*,/), paréntesis, literales numéricos, identificadores, comparaciones. Soporte para precedencia de operadores.
acceptance_criteria: Parses arithmetic expressions with correct precedence

tasks.title: Implementar Interpreter
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Interpreter.ts con función execute(ast: Program, model: Registry): void. Recorrer AST, crear entidades en el Registro, validar dependencias, manejar errores de ejecución.
acceptance_criteria: execute() processes Program and populates Registry
References to undefined entities produce clear errors

tasks.title: Implementar errores del DSL
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Errors.ts con tipos de error: LexerError, ParseError, RuntimeError, ReferenceError. Cada uno con mensaje, span, y sugerencia cuando sea posible.
acceptance_criteria: LexerError with line/column and invalid character
ParseError with line/column, expected vs found
RuntimeError with entity name and description
ReferenceError with undefined name and suggestion
All errors have toString() with formatted message

tasks.title: Implementar sistema de unidades
tasks.description: Crear src/dsl/Units.ts con parseUnit(value: string, unit: string): number. Conversiones: cm→mm (*10), in→mm (*25.4), mm→mm (*1). Default unit si no se especifica.

tasks.title: Implementar INPUT declarations
tasks.description: Añadir al parser e interpreter: INPUT name = value { constraints }. Permitir INPUT como parámetros externos del patrón. Validar constraints en runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Constraint violation produces error with description
INPUT values available to subsequent expressions

tasks.title: Implementar LET bindings
tasks.description: Añadir al parser e interpreter: LET name = expression. Permitir cálculos intermedios que referencian INPUTs y otros LETs.
acceptance_criteria: Expression evaluated with correct operator precedence
LET can reference previous LETs and INPUTs

tasks.title: Implementar point methods (.UP, .DOWN, .LEFT, .RIGHT)
tasks.description: Añadir al parser: point.METHOD(args). Métodos: UP(dy), DOWN(dy), LEFT(dx), RIGHT(dx), TOWARD(point, dist), ROTATE(angle, center).
acceptance_criteria: origin.RIGHT(quarter_hip) creates point to the right
Method calls parsed as expression with receiver

tasks.title: Definir modelo Piece
tasks.description: Crear src/pattern/Piece.ts con interfaz Piece {name, contour: Path, constructionLines: Path[], grainline?: Segment, foldline?: Segment, notches: Notch[], labels: Label[], seamAllowanceWidth: number}.
acceptance_criteria: Piece interface with all required fields
Notches array with position and depth

tasks.title: Implementar SeamAllowance
tasks.description: Crear src/pattern/SeamAllowance.ts con función addSeamAllowance(piece, width): Piece que retorna nueva pieza con contorno offset. Usar Offset.ts del módulo geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Seam allowance = offset path at given width

tasks.title: Implementar Notch y Grainline
tasks.description: Crear src/pattern/Notch.ts (interfaz Notch {position, depth, angle}) y src/pattern/Grainline.ts (función createGrainline(start, end)).
acceptance_criteria: Grainline is a directed segment with arrow
Grainline parallel to specified edge or absolute

tasks.title: Implementar renderizado de Piece a SVG
tasks.description: Añadir a SVG Renderer: renderPiece(piece, options) que genera grupo SVG con: contour (cut line), seam allowance (if enabled), construction lines, notches, grainline, labels.
acceptance_criteria: Piece renders as <g> with id and class
Contour renders as <path> with cut-line class
Construction lines render as dotted paths
Notches render as short perpendicular lines

tasks.title: Implementar Dart
tasks.description: Crear src/pattern/Dart.ts con función createDart(apex, leg1, leg2): Dart que representa triángulo de pinza. Incluir rotación de pinza alrededor de apex.
acceptance_criteria: Dart has apex, two legs, width
createDart from apex and two edge points
Dart can be rotated around apex

tasks.title: Implementar ReferenceValidator
tasks.description: Crear src/validation/ReferenceValidator.ts con función validateReferences(model: Registry): ValidationResult que verifica que todas las referencias existen.

tasks.title: Implementar GeometryValidator
tasks.description: Crear src/validation/GeometryValidator.ts con funciones: validateDegenerate(geometry), validateCurves(geometry). Detectar: points too close, zero-length segments, degenerate curves.
acceptance_criteria: Detects degenerate Bezier curves (all control points same)

tasks.title: Implementar PathValidator
tasks.description: Crear src/validation/PathValidator.ts con funciones: validateClosure(path, tolerance), validateSelfIntersection(path). Detectar paths abiertos y autointersecciones.
acceptance_criteria: validateClosure checks gap between last and first point

tasks.title: Implementar CLI base
tasks.description: Crear src/cli/index.ts con entrada CLI usando process.argv. Soportar comandos: build, inspect, validate, export. Sin dependencias externas de argument parsing.

tasks.title: Implementar comando build
tasks.description: Implementar sastre build <file.sastre> que: parse → execute → render → write SVG. Mostrar errores formateados si falla.
acceptance_criteria: Exit code 0 on success, 1 on error

tasks.title: Implementar comando validate
tasks.description: Implementar sastre validate <file.sastre> que: parse → execute → run all validators → report results.
acceptance_criteria: Runs all validators on parsed model
Reports each validation error with location
Exit code 0 if no errors, 1 if errors found

tasks.title: Implementar comando inspect
tasks.description: Implementar sastre inspect <file.sastre> que: parse → execute → listar entidades, mostrar tipos, valores, dependencias.
acceptance_criteria: Lists all entities with names and types
Shows resolved values for each entity
Formatted output for human and machine consumption

tasks.title: Implementar comandos de inspección
tasks.description: Añadir a CLI: inspect point <name>, inspect curve <name>, inspect path <name>, inspect measure <path>, inspect bbox <name>, inspect deps <name>.
acceptance_criteria: inspect curve shows control points and type
inspect path shows segments and length

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Rectángulo
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/rectangle.sastre que define un rectángulo simple de 200x300mm. Validar: 4 puntos, 4 segmentos, área = 60000mm², bounding box correcto.

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Forma poligonal
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/polygon.sastre con forma de 5+ lados. Validar: vértices correctos, área calculada, perímetro.
acceptance_criteria: Perimeter matches sum of edge lengths

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Contorno con curvas
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/curved.sastre con contorno que incluye al menos una curva Bezier cúbica. Validar: curva evaluada correctamente, longitud del path.
acceptance_criteria: Contains Bezier curve with 4 control points

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Pieza simple
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/simple_piece.sastre con una pieza de patrón básica (contorno cerrado + seam allowance). Validar: pieza válida, SA offset correcto.
acceptance_criteria: Seam allowance applied at constant width
SA contour is larger than sewing contour

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Delantero de boxer
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/boxer_front.sastre con pieza delantera de boxer (rectangular + curva de tiro). Validar: dimensiones correctas según medidas, curva de tiro suave.
acceptance_criteria: boxer_front.sastre defines INPUTs (hip, waist, rise, inseam)
Points derived from measurements with correct formulas
Contour includes straight edges and crotch curve
Crotch curve is Bezier (not sharp corner)

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Trasero de boxer
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/boxer_back.sastre con pieza trasera de boxer (similar a delantera pero con curva de tiro más profunda y mayor ancho).
acceptance_criteria: boxer_back.sastre uses same INPUTs as front
Back crotch curve extends further than front
Back width > front width at hip

tasks.title: Patrón de referencia: Boxer completo
tasks.description: Crear tests/patterns/boxer_complete.sastre con todas las piezas (front, back, waistband, fly). Validar: todas las piezas renderizan, dimensiones consistentes entre piezas.
acceptance_criteria: Front and back pieces have matching seam lengths at side seam
All pieces fit within reasonable bounding box
SVG shows all pieces with labels
notes: Final integration test — validates entire pipeline

tasks.title: Tests de integración Geometry→SVG
tasks.description: Tests que crean geometría directamente (sin DSL) y verifican que el renderer SVG produce output correcto: path commands, coordinates, groups, viewBox.
acceptance_criteria: Test: create line → render → verify <line> element
Test: create Bezier → render → verify <path> with C command
Test: create polygon → render → verify closed <path>

tasks.title: Tests de integración DSL→Geometry
tasks.description: Tests que parsean código DSL y verifican que el modelo geométrico resultante tiene las entidades correctas con valores correctos.
